articles.title: Série especial do g1 com 50 vídeos explica as eleições de 2026 | G1
articles.standfirst: O g1 reuniu informação, serviço e especialistas para explicar desde o funcionamento do sistema político até as dúvidas que podem aparecer na hora de votar.
articles.summary: O g1 reuniu informação, serviço e especialistas para explicar desde o funcionamento do sistema político até as dúvidas que podem aparecer na hora de votar.
articles.body:
Domingo (4) é dia de votação no primeiro turno das eleições. O g1 preparou uma cobertura especial: uma série especial de 50 vídeos .

Qual é a ordem de votação? O que faz um senador? Pode beber no dia da eleição? Essas são só algumas das perguntas que a gente respondeu sobre as eleições de 2026. Em uma série especial de 50 vídeos , o g1 reuniu informação, serviço e especialistas para explicar desde o funcionamento do sistema político até as dúvidas que podem aparecer na hora de votar.

Um dos temas são as pesquisas eleitorais. O diretor da Quaest, Felipe Nunes, responde às principais dúvidas: para que servem as pesquisas eleitorais? E as margens de erro, o que significam? E pesquisa consegue prever o resultado?

Série especial do g1 com 50 vídeos explica as eleições de 2026 — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Essa é a primeira eleição depois do boom das ferramentas de inteligência artificial capazes de criar imagens e vídeos hiper-realistas. O g1 explica como essa tecnologia entrou na campanha, quais as regras e o que significam termos como deepfake, bots e algoritmos.

Na série “Funciona Assim”, os repórteres mostram como funciona a urna eletrônica e explicam o papel dos cargos em disputa. Tem também uma série gravada em Brasília para mostrar o que acontece depois que deputados e senadores são eleitos. Como funcionam a Câmara, o Senado e as principais engrenagens do Congresso.

O Guia do Eleitor tira suas dúvidas na hora de votar. Que documentos levar? Como justificar a ausência? O que pode e o que não pode na cabine de votação?

São 50 vídeos para ajudar a entender a eleição antes, durante e depois do voto. Já dá até para maratonar. Está tudo no g1 .

articles.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' box office collection Day 1: Ajay Devgn starrer misses Rs 100 crore opening; scores Rs 95 crore global debut
articles.summary: Ajay Devgn’s ‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ has made a strong start at the global box office, however, it fell short of the Rs 100 crore mark.
articles.body: Ajay Devgn’s ‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ has made a strong start at the global box office, however, it fell short of the Rs 100 crore mark.According to sacnilk, the film' starring Ajay Devgn in the lead, collected Rs 66.75 crore net in India on Day 1 across 15,759 shows. Its India gross stands at Rs 80.10 crore, while the film added another Rs 15 crore gross from overseas markets, thus taking its worldwide gross to an estimated Rs 95.10 crore.The film recorded an overall 67.08% occupancy for its Hindi 2D shows. After a relatively slow start during the morning shows, the thriller witnessed an upturn in its footfalls through the day, recording its highest occupancy during the night shows at 76.46%.Drishyam 3 Movie Review‘Drishyam 3’ beats ‘Drishyam 2’ and 'Drishyam' opening‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ has registered a substantially bigger opening than its predecessor, ‘Drishyam 2’. The second instalment reportedly collected Rs 15.38 crore net and Rs 18.15 crore gross in India on its opening day. Meanwhile, the first instalment of the film opened at Rs 5.85 crore net at the domestic box office.‘Drishyam 3’ marks Ajay Devgn's biggest openingThe latest film also marks the biggest opening day of Ajay Devgn’s career. As per box office reports, ‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’, which released on October 2, 2026, has been reported to have collected around Rs 66 crore net on its opening day. This is much higher than the opening day collection of 'Singham Again' which earned Rs 43.70 crore, 'Singham Returns' which earned Rs 32.09 crore and 'Golmaal Again' which earned Rs 30.14 crore.Strong advance bookingsThe film had recorded substantial advance sales ahead of its release. ‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ reportedly sold Rs 79.71 crore worth of tickets across eight show dates, including block seats. Without block seats, the advance booking figure stood at Rs 67.79 crore.The strong pre-release demand set the ball rolling for the huge opennig day numbers.‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ plotDrishyam: The Conclusion marks the next chapter in Vijay Salgaonkar's story, with Ajay Devgn returning in the lead role. Set years after Vijay Salgaonkar successfully evaded the law, the film follows the renewed investigation and pressure surrounding the family. Meera Deshmukh returns, this time driven by revenge, while a powerful new Crime Branch officer attempts to dismantle Vijay’s carefully constructed alibis and psychological defences.‘Drishyam 3’ to cross 'Drishyam' lifetime collection in opening weekendWith Rs 95.10 crore worldwide collected on Day 1, the film is already within striking distance of the Rs 100 crore mark. It is also on course to surpass the lifetime worldwide collection of the 2015 Hindi remake, ‘Drishyam’, which earned approximately Rs 110.40 crore during its theatrical run.The original Hindi film collected around Rs 90.63 crore gross in India and Rs 19.77 crore overseas, taking its worldwide total to approximately Rs 110.40 crore.'Drishyam 3' cast'Drishyam: The Conclusion' also stars Tabu, Shriya Saran, Jaideep Ahlawat, Prakash Raj, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav and Kamlesh Sawant. It is directed by Abhishek Pathak and written by Pathak along with Aamil Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Salman Khan salutes hero pilot Smit Machchhar after averting FlyDubai crisis; says 'will be a pleasure to fly with u... Well done bro'
articles.summary: Bollywood's bhaijaan, Salman Khan has become the latest celebrity to laud Captain Smit Machchhar, the Indian pilot who helped save over 100 lives on a
articles.body: Bollywood's bhaijaan, Salman Khan has become the latest celebrity to laud Captain Smit Machchhar, the Indian pilot who helped save over 100 lives on a FlyDubai flight.Taking to his X handle, Salman shared a message of appreciation for Machchhar, who was seriously injured when he was allegedly attacked by his co-pilot mid-air. In his tweet, Khan wrote, “Kamaal kar diya pilot ji, hum sab aap ko salute karte hain will be a pleasure to fly with u.. Well done bro.. Capt #SmitMachchhar."As per reports, Machchhar was piloting FlyDubai Flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30 when the co-pilot allegedly attacked him inside the cockpit. Despite sustaining injuries, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door, after which passengers and crew members entered the cockpit and helped restrain the attacker.The aircraft was eventually diverted and made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. As per a report on Reuters, more than 170 people were on board, and all occupants reached safety.Salman is among several Indian celebrities to publicly acknowledge Machchhar’s heroism. Shilpa Shetty also posted, “Heart goes out to everyone affected. And immense respect for Captain Smit Machchhar for bringing over 170 lives to safety.”Actor Jackie Shroff also praised the pilot saying, “Some heroes work in silence! All my respects to Captain Smit Machchhar and the other brave heroes for saving lives and averting a massive tragedy.”Vicky Kaushal shared a picture of Captain Machchhar in the cockpit on his Instagram Stories and simply wrote, “Braveheart! Capt Smit Machchhar.”Sunny Deol also shared a picture of the injured pilot and wrote, “Captain Smit Machchhar – extraordinary courage and presence of mind when it mattered most. You helped avert a disaster and save lives. Wishing you a speedy recovery. Salute.”Tamannaah Bhatia, meanwhile, shared a text post highlighting the responsibility Sumit Machchhar was carrying while fighting for his own life. She wrote, “Imagine being injured, fighting for your own life and still thinking about the 174 lives that are relying on you. Captain Smit Machchhar, so much respect Praying for your recovery”On the work front, Salman Khan is currently shooting for 'Bigg Boss' and is also shooting his action entertainer directed by Vamshi Paidipally, co-starring Nayanthara. He is also awaiting the release of his war film, 'Maatrubhumi' which is still awaiting its release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber want to take legal action following Presley Gerber’s passing: ‘Want accountability'
articles.summary: Following the tragic overdose of Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber are considering legal action against the sober house and his coach, seeking answers and accountability.
articles.body: Presley Gerber, son of famed model Cindy Crawford and partner Rande Gerber, passed away last month at a sober house due to an apparent drug overdose and cardiac arrest. The news sent shockwaves across the industry as the 27-year-old had always been vocal about his struggle with substances. Now, according to the latest reports shared online, Crawford and Gerber are considering taking legal action against the sober house where he was found, along with his sober coach.Here’s what we know so far about the matter.Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber are considering legal action after Presley Gerber’s demiseRadarOnline.com reported recently that the model and the businessman are considering taking the legal route to deal with the aftermath of their son’s passing. According to the report, the couple is looking for answers and accountability after their son passed away in his private room after checking into the Santa Monica treatment facility.A statement from the report read, "Cindy and Rande don’t just want answers—they want accountability. They are exploring every legal option available. If mistakes were made, they want consequences," further adding, “Their son was taken there because he needed help. The question they are asking is, how did a vulnerable 27-year-old end up alone in a room just hours before he died? Who was responsible for watching him?”Another statement from Rob Shuter’s ‘Naughty But Nice’ page added that they are looking to shut the case down and seek proper answers into what happened to their son to ensure no other family goes through anything like this.The sober house and Presley Gerber’s sober coach knew about his conditionAccording to an earlier report shared by TMZ, Gerber’s sober coach was well aware that the model had been using again. Despite this, he contacted the sober house, inquiring whether they had space for him, to which an attendant at the facility agreed to house him for the night. The report also stated that the facility employee was well aware Gerber was under the influence and, despite rules and regulations, let him stay there.The outlet also shared Gerber’s final moments online: a video in which the 27-year-old was seen filming himself. After that, he panned the camera around to share a glimpse of the facility where he was staying. In the video, he wore a chain and a white tank top as he showed the camera around the facility, which included a community sleeping area with several beds, a balcony area with a view of the nearby mountains and the recreational area in the yard.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ box office collection day 57: Neem Karoli Baba's film earns Rs 2.35 crore net in India
articles.summary: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ began its box office run on a quiet note, with little early buzz to suggest what lay ahead.
articles.body: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ began its box office run on a quiet note, with little early buzz to suggest what lay ahead. As word of mouth spread, the film steadily gained momentum, with its collections climbing week after week and turning it into a surprise success story. The devotional drama has now wrapped up seven weeks in theatres and has stepped into its eighth, a run that very few films manage to sustain. It continues to draw audiences even after nearly two months since its release.‘Hanuman Ansh’ box office collection on day 57On Day 57, Hanuman Ansh collected Rs 2.35 crore net in India, across 1,166 shows. Sacnilk reported that the film's India net collection has now reached Rs 319.73 crore, while its India gross stands at Rs 377.66 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ week-wise box office collection‘Hanuman Ansh’ had a modest start, earning Rs 10 lakh on its opening day and Rs 1.08 crore by the end of Week 1. Week 2 brought in Rs 40 lakh, but the film picked up sharply in Week 3 with Rs 10.40 crore. It then pulled in Rs 61 crore in Week 4 and hit its peak in Week 5 with Rs 90.25 crore, its best weekly haul. Collections stood at Rs 80.25 crore in Week 6 and Rs 44.80 crore in Week 7. In Week 8, the film collected Rs 3.35 crore on Day 50, Rs 6.50 crore on Day 51 and Rs 9 crore on Day 52, followed by Rs 2.25 crore on Day 53, Rs 3 crore on Day 54, Rs 2.20 crore on Day 55 and Rs 1.65 crore on Day 56.About ‘Hanuman Ansh’, cast and releaseThe film is a Hindi devotional drama inspired by the life and teachings of Neem Karoli Baba, which arrived in theatres on August 7, 2026. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, ‘Hanuman Ansh’ features Chandan Anand, Gulshan Pandey, Shobhinaw Satyaa, Anil Rastogi and Purnima Tiwari in key roles. To reach a wider audience, a Telugu-dubbed version is also being released, and the makers have lined up an international release to carry the story beyond India's borders.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Emma Roberts shares wedding pictures with husband Cody John: 'Hitched'
articles.summary: Emma Roberts shares beautiful wedding moments with Cody John, showcasing their special day with heartwarming photos and glimpses of their love story.
articles.body: Actress Emma Roberts has finally shared glimpses from her wedding with husband Cody John.The actress, who got married on July 25 with her son walking her down the aisle, shared a string of images. The first was the couple sharing a kiss.She also included shots of them exchanging vows and walking down the aisle hand-in-hand, celebrating their new nuptials.Emma captioned the post "Hitched," giving fans a peek into the couple's wedding celebrations.Roberts began dating actor Cody John in August 2022. In July 2024, she used Instagram to announce their engagement.Emma is popular for her work in multiple genres of film and television. Her work in the horror and thriller genres have established her as a scream queen.After making her acting debut in the crime film Blow, the actress gained recognition for her lead role as Addie Singer in television teen sitcom Unfabulous.For the series, she released her debut soundtrack album, Unfabulous and More. She went on to appear in numerous films including Aquamarine, Nancy Drew, Wild Child, Hotel for Dogs, Valentine's Day, It's Kind of a Funny Story, and The Art of Getting By.She went on to star in mature roles such as Lymelife, 4.3.2.1., Scream 4, Adult World, We're the Millers, and Gia Coppola's Palo Alto.Emma has since appeared in 'The Blackcoat's Daughter', 'Nerve', 'Who We Are Now', 'Paradise Hills', 'Holidate', and the 'Marvel superhero film 'Madame Web.'The actress was last seen in 'Saurus City', an American stop-motion fantasy film written and directed by Nate Smith. The film also stars Ron Perlman, Emma Roberts, Dennis Quaid, Tim Meadows, Aimee Garcia, and Julia Ormond.The film followed the tale of a knight who, when called upon to help a young lady in distress, discovers that the entire Dinosaur Kingdom is in danger.She will next be seen in the film 'The Technique'.
